skill: Electric guitar technique with pentatonic scales and loop pedal usage
desired_outcome: Be able to freely play melodies using pentatonic scales on the electric guitar and use a loop pedal to create backing tracks and harmonies for blues riffs.
target_context: Practice 30 minutes per day, 5 days per week, for 8 weeks, using electric guitar, amplifier, loop pedal, tuner, cable, picks, strap.
success_definition: Can play pentatonic scales across two positions with accurate fingering and clean tone at a moderate tempo
Can improvise an 8- to 12-bar blues melodic phrase using pentatonic scales over a looped backing track
Can create and overdub at least one loop on the loop pedal, layering a rhythm track with a melodic pentatonic phrase
Can switch between pentatonic scale positions smoothly while staying in key
Maintains guitar tuning during practice using the tuner
motivation: Intrinsic motivation to develop melodic guitar playing with looping for blues-inspired improvisation.
constraints: Equipment available: electric guitar, amplifier, loop pedal, tuner, cable, picks, strap
No prior formal training in guitar or music theory
assumptions: Practices 30 minutes per day, 5 days per week
Access to loop pedal capable of recording, overdubbing, and playback
Standard tuning and basic amp settings assumed
Practice environment allows use of a metronome
No external performance requirement during the horizon
